220	* **11.5** **Menu Grid/Action** — Menu list page grouped by concept: search/filter, create/edit/delete menu modals, menu status (R&D, Active, Dormant).
221	* **11.6** **MAD Menu Dashboard** — Menu Architecture & Development (MAD) dashboard: menu stage gates (Discovery through Pilot), item/packaged goods/raw materials cards, cost metrics, sodium/calorie tracking, missing fields, progress validation.
222	* **11.7** **Missing Fields** — "Missing Fields" column and flyout in MAD dashboard showing per-item counts of fields required for publishing, with detailed flyout listing each missing field.
223	* **11.8** **Comments & Issues** — Comments and issue-tracking system: adding comments, marking as issues with user assignment, resolve/reopen permissions, starring users, display in MAD and item detail pages.
224	* **11.9** **Export Menu Items in MAD** — Bulk-export selected menu item PDFs from MAD dashboard with permission control and file naming convention.
225	* **11.10** **Global Notification** — Global notification flyout with three tabs: Your Comments, Missing Fields (filterable by menu and team), and Issues (assigned to current user).
226	
227	12. Scheduled changes
228	---------------------
229	
230	Scheduled Changes page listing item BOM versions with effective time ranges, plus a Change Ticket system for grouping draft items, publishing them together, and managing component dependencies.
231

233	-------------
234	
235	User list feature including private starred lists (auto-generated from starred items on the item grid), publishable lists reusing the MAD dashboard layout, and list management actions.
236	
237	14. Configurations
238	------------------
239	
240	* **14.1** **Allergens** — Allergen configuration listing all allergen types with sub-types, app visibility flags, label visibility settings, and UI display rules.
241	* **14.2** **Concept Configuration** — Managing food concepts: CRUD operations, mapping concepts to brands/restaurants, search functionality, validation rules for concept-brand relationships.
242	* **14.3** **Brand** — Brand management: creating, editing, soft-deleting brands, linking to concepts and Merch, validation rules for deletion.

244	* **14.5** **Items' Attributes** — Tagging, bulk-editing, and importing attribute values on items via Excel template, with validation, permission handling, and audit logging.
245	* **14.6** **Preparation** — Preparations management: grid listing with name, type (Process/Reference), usage count, active status, CRUD operations, detail pages, soft-delete with usage validation.
246	* **14.7** **Locations**
247

249	  + **14.7.2** **ERP Item Fields** — ERP Item Fields configuration: managing field values (Classification, Pick By Type) and Kitchen Sub-Locations, CRUD, duplicate validation, occupancy checks.

252	  + **14.7.5** **Printer Route** — Printer Route management: ZPL file upload with template parameter validation, label size, usage tracking, soft-delete restrictions.
253	* **14.8** **Unit** — Unit configuration: managing Cookbook units (synced with ERP), OG UOMs, and global unit conversions.
254	* **14.9** **Manage Dietary** — Dietary tag management: create, edit, delete with duplicate validation, usage checks, integration with mobile app dietary preference page.
255	* **14.10** **Sync Job Log** — ERP Sync Job Log and OG Sync Log pages for tracking sync jobs between Cookbook and ERP/Order Grid, including status filtering, failure details, re-sync actions.
256	* **14.11** **Agent Configuration** — AI agent configuration UI: tabs for managing multiple agents (Master, Cookbook, Jira, BigQuery), each with model/prompt settings, and a Prompt Library.
257	* **14.12** **Filter Code** — Filter Code configuration: maintaining filter codes (Storage, ASM, Outbound types) synced with ERP, with CRUD and duplicate validation.

1	# Cookbook-Full-Feature
2	
3	Local mirror of the Confluence page tree **[Cookbook Full Features Detail Requirements](https://wonder.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RT/pages/3954803247)** (space RT), fetched 2026-06-12. 179 pages, full unmodified bodies, directory layout = original Confluence hierarchy with original page titles.
4	
5	## Entry point
6	
7	Read **`Cookbook Full Features Detail Requirements.md`** first — it is the AI-navigable summary index: every feature page with a one-line description and section numbering (1–15). Use it to locate the exact file, then read only that file.
8	
9	## Structure
10	
11	| Folder / file | Confluence section | Contents |
12	|---|---|---|
13	| `Fields & Cards in Items.md` | 1 | Card/field × item-type display matrix |
14	| `Common Features/` | 2 | Copy/Delete/Create/Update/Publish version, item & version status, validations, inventory flags, `Backend Features/` (jobs + Pantry/KDS APIs) |
15	| `Item Grid/` | 3 | Grid, create item, bulk edits, exports (ERP/nutrition/all-data) |
16	| `Item Details/` | 4 | The biggest section. Subfolders: `Item Information/`, `Components/`, `Customization V2/`, `Nutritions/`, `Logistics Card/`, `Food Science Card/`, `88 Item Assembly Instructions Card/`, `Usages/`, `Procedure Card/`, `Hot Holding Card/` + ~20 standalone card pages (Production, Regulation Labeling, Unit Conversion, Decant Loss, Packaged SKUs, Vendor Items Card, …) |
17	| `HDR Consumable Item 40 Detail.md` | 5 | 40\* object type detail page & downstream sync |
18	| `Line Build/` | 6 | Line build page, tasks, steps/sub-steps, validation, training card, multi-usage & option-value variants |
19	| `Benchtop Recipe/` | 7 | Benchtop details, commercialize item |
20	| `Variant-Test Kitchen/` | 8 | Variant list/create/details |
21	| `WSKUs & Consumables Grid/` | 9 | 41\*/40\* grid, new-40 creation workflow, linked-WSKU change history |
22	| `Vendor Items/` | 10 | OG sync rule, SKU mappings, vendor item validation |
23	| `Menu/` | 11 | Menu grid/details, exports, scale recipe, MAD dashboard, missing fields, comments & issues, notifications |
24	| `Scheduled changes.md` | 12 | Scheduled changes grid + change tickets |
25	| `User List.md` | 13 | Starred & published user lists |
26	| `Configurations/` | 14 | Allergens, concepts, brands, attributes, preparations, `Locations/`, units, dietary, sync logs, agent config, filter codes |
27	| `Features TBD/` | 15 | Create-item flows (ingredient/recipe/packaged/40\*/41\*/benchtop), 41-40 cutover deprecations |
28	| `Copy of Sync packaged item to vendor catalog service.md` | — | 88\* → VCS field mapping spec |
29	
30	## Conventions
31	
32	- Every file has frontmatter: `title`, `confluence_id`, `confluence_url`, `parent`, `fetched`.
33	- A page with children = a folder named after the page; if the page itself has body content, it sits inside as `<Page Title>.md`. A leaf page = a plain `.md`. Confluence container pages with empty bodies (e.g. Item Details, Components, Nutritions, Usages) are folders only — no `.md` counterpart.
34	- Title sanitization only where required: `/` → `-`, `*` dropped. Confluence typos kept verbatim ("Recipa Basic Information Card", "Menu Item Assemly Instructions").
35	- This is an external reference KB (like `cb-bigquery` / `cb-business`): no vault frontmatter schema, not indexed by INDEX.base main views, load lazily, do not cook into agent pages.
36	- To refresh: refetch by `confluence_id` and overwrite; structure mirrors Confluence so new pages slot in by parent.
37	- **Images**: all 1211 attachment images are mirrored locally under `Attachments/<confluence_page_id>/<original filename>` (~71MB, 1400 files) and the `.md` files reference them by relative path, so they render in Obsidian. `Attachments/` is gitignored (refetchable: list via `/wiki/rest/api/content/<pageId>/child/attachment`, download via `.../child/attachment/<attId>/download` with basic auth). Two `UNKNOWN_ATTACHMENT` refs kept as remote URLs — broken on the Confluence source pages themselves.

25	**Main Scenario**
26	=================
27	
28	1. List all change logs of a version of 'recipe' item in the 'Change History' card. (Means we record change logs for each version of item and display them in card respectively according to versions.) (40/41 items are supported in MD-17159)
29	2. Show a toggle 'Exclude Logs Updated by System', default to unselect.
30	
31	   1. Toggling on to filter out the change logs which is updated by recipe system from the change history table.
32	   2. The last updated by includes 'recipe system', case insensitive.
33	   3. User can toggle off it manually.
34	3. Add paging bar for both 'change history' and 'versions' tables.
35	4. Add change log:
36	
37	   1. Cooking and Preparations: for ingredient item
38	   2. Space Management: for non-food item
39	   3. vendor items /Procurement Specs: for ingredient/non-food item
40	   4. Basic Information /Unit Conversion and Attributes: for all object type
41	   5. Logistics, production, Procurement Specs: for ingredient/commissary item/ packaged item/HDR recipe
42	   6. Food Science: for commissary item/ packaged item/ ingredient item/HDR recipe
43	   7. customization, Guest Packaging, Smallwares: for truck item
44	   8. assembly instructions: for kit/single/multi/truck stock item
45	   9. Hot Hold: for packaged item
46	   10. Record a change log when the preset is changed: creating a new preset/delete preset/update preset name, added/removed options from a preset. Triggered by: Updated preset.
47	5. When 'Production Start Time' or 'Production End Time' is changed, record a change log.
48	6. When updated Cooking and Preparations, the following changes will record the change log. When the preparation is removed or added, yield of preparation is updated, yield of ingredient is updated. (The change of usage won't record a change log). Last Updated By: the user who add/edit preparation yield.
49	7. The change of cost auto-calculated by system won't record the change log.
50	8. The change of any card in data base (exactly change) will generate a record of change log of a recipe. (E.g., Basic Information, ERP Item Information, Components, Procedure, Nutrition & Allergens, Production, Version Information, BOM, Assembly Instructions, Hot Hold, Kitting Instruction, Customization, Line Build, Food Science, Receivian'yan'yng Info, Cooking and Preparations, Unit Conversions, Attributes, Guest Packaging, Smallwares, etc)
51	
52	   1. We should compare if the recipe data is changed exactly or not.
53	   2. When user edits BOM/component of a menu/recipe item, if there is no exactly change in BOM/component, please don't generate a change log.
54	   3. When user edits BOM of a packaged/HDR recipe, if there is no exactly change in BOM/component, please don't generate a change log.
55	   4. When user edits component of a benchtop item, if there is no exactly change in component, please don't generate a change log.
56	   5. When the Regulation Labeling card is updated, record a change log.
57	
58	      1. E.g., Regulatory Body, Statement of Identity, Ingredients List, Allergens List
59	      2. Triggered by: Updated Regulation Labeling
60	   6. When concept updated, record a change history:
61	
62	      1. Trigger by: Updated {card name}
63	      2. If the change of concept is triggered by changing truck item's BOM/Component/customization or edit truck item's concept
64	      3. Updated by: the user who make the change
65	      4. Trigger by: 'Updated Concept'
66	      5. Truck item {Item Number} (V#) usage updated, change #
67	      6. Truck item {Item Number} (V#) concept updated, change # '
68	      7. If the change of concept is triggered by the new version takes effect (e.g., change the effective time of parent item/sub item), then the version is auto recalculated by cookbook system
69	      8. updated by= 'Recipe System'
70	      9. Trigger by: Updated Concept
71	9. After created a recipe, record the change log and snapshot.
72	
73	   ![image-20250903-064151.png](../../Attachments/4220485721/image-20250903-064151.png)
74	10. In 'Change History' data, including columns 'No.', 'Trigger By', 'Last Updated By', 'Last Updated Time' and 'Actions'.
75	11. If there are multi change logs, display them as following mockup:
76

78	
79	    When user clicks 'View' to open comparison page, the heading should display as **"V{version number} Change #{No.}"** format. E.g., "V3 Change #29".
80	12. If the change triggered by action of a specific user (e.g., bulk edit, edit in UI level), the last updated by= user name, Triggered by= 'Updated {change of card name1}, {change of card name2}'
81

83	13. 'Trigger By': means what trigger to generate a change log

## Complete Documentation Analysis of /Users/bonnie/bonnie-knowledge/Z01-Resource/CB-full-feature/

The directory is a local mirror of the Confluence page tree "Cookbook Full Features Detail Requirements" (space RT), fetched 2026-06-12. It contains 179 pages with full unmodified bodies. Container pages with empty bodies (like Item Details, Components) are folders only with no `.md` counterpart. Images are mirrored locally under `Attachments/<confluence_page_id>/`.

The documentation is organized into 15 sections:

1. **Fields & Cards in Items** - Card/field x item-type display matrix

14. **Configurations** - Allergens, concepts, brands, attributes, preparations, locations, units, dietary, sync logs, agent config
15. **Features TBD** - Create-item flows, 41-40 cutover deprecations

### 3. Procedure Card (`Item Details/Procedure Card/Procedure Card.md`)

**Summary:** The Procedure Card (V2) is for recipe items (commissary 800* and benchtop). It shows instruction details, Labor Time, and Skill Level. Key requirements:

- Card name: "Procedure (V2)" with a pencil icon for editing
- When no procedure exists, show a state with no instructions
- **Skill Level**: Single select, originally required, changed to optional for recipe items (turned from required to optional). Values: Level 1 (lowest) through Level 5 (highest). Hidden from benchtop recipes.
- **Labor Time**: Required. Format: xx hour xx min xx sec. Tip: "Labor time is the total time it takes 1 person to finish a procedure. Labor time includes cook time."
- Instructions: "Add Instruction" button, free text up to 999 characters, drag-and-drop reordering, delete with 'x' icon
- **Blast Chiller Final Step?** toggle, defaults to Yes
- Right column shows "List of Components" tab (with columns: COMPONENT, TYPE/SUB TYPE, USAGE - drag to reorder) and "Instruction Guidelines" tab
- Guidelines state: at most one appliance, at most one tool, at most 3 disposables, must include labor time

**Validation (from Item Validations-Missing Info):** Procedure card validation:
- Field: Procedure
- Item Types: Commissary (800)*, Benchtop - **required**
- Validation Type: At least one line with text added (exclude benchtop-byproduct)
- Owner: CDT
- If missing: shows "Procedure (missing)" and redirects to create the card

### 4. Appliance & Equipment Card (`Item Details/Procedure Card/Appliance & Equipment.md`)

**Summary:** Shown for recipe/88* items. Key sections:

- **Appliances**: Culinary equipment using heat. Dropdown: None, Rational Oven, Clamshell, Water Bath, Tilt Skillet, Conventional Fryer, Pressure Fryer, Tilt Kettle, Grill, Flat Top, Stove Top. Single select, required.
- **Equipment**: Mechanical without heat. Dropdown: None, Hobart Grinder, Hobart Mixer/Kitchen Aid Mixer, Vita-Mix, Immersion Blender, Robot Coupe, Sammic, Deli Slicer, MultiVac Sealer, Vacuum Tumbler. Single select, required.
- **Disposables**: Single-use non-food items, max 3, optional. Searchable non-food items with quantity configuration (up to 4 decimal places).
- **Resource Information** (right column): Minimum Batch Size, Min batch UOM, Number of cooks for minimum batch, Time for minimum batch, Maximum batch size, Max batch UOM, Number of cooks for maximum batch, Time for maximum batch, Time to reset equipment, **Resource Name** (required, single select from 28 options like All Fill, B2B Freezer, Band Sealer, etc.)
- Resource Name validation: If empty when saving, highlighted with "Resource Name is required"
- Preset program creation supported for Rational Oven and Clamshell

### 5. Parameters of Appliance & Equipment (`Item Details/Procedure Card/Parameters of Appliance & Equipment.md`)

Defines detailed parameters for each appliance preset program and equipment settings:

- **Rational Oven**: Program Name, Mode (Steam/Hot air/Combination - multi select), Humidity (%), Finishing Point (Cook Time or Final Core Temperature), Fan Speed (1-5)
- **Clamshell**: Recipe Type (Clam/Flat), Upper/Lower Temp (F), Removal Time (seconds), Gap (for non-Flat)
- **Water Bath**: Temperature, Required Final Temp (F), Max Load per Bath, Cook Time
- **Tilt Skillet**: Setting (Boil/Braise), Temperature (F), Pressurization (optional), Cook Time
- **Conventional Fryer**: Temperature (F), Required Final Temp (F), Max Batch Quantity, Approx. Cook Time, Fried from Frozen?
- **Pressure Fryer**: Program Name (Legs/4PC Wings/Thighs/Breasts/Filet/Tenders), Required Final Temp, Requires Vegelene, Approx. Cook Time, Quantity per Basket
- **Tilt Kettle**: Temperature (F), Required Final Temp, Max Batch Quantity, Approx. Cook Time
- **Grill**: Finishing Point (Final Temp/Max Internal Temp), Approx. Cook Time
- **Flat Top**: Dial Setting, Required Final Temp, Approx. Cook Time, Broil checkbox
- **Stove Top**: Set Temperature (Low through High), Required Final Temperature, Approx. Cook Time

### 7. Publishing Workflow (`Common Features/Publish Version.md`)

**Version History highlights:** Most recent update v1.9 (04/02/2026, MD-17334) enabled non-BOM item for customization warnings.

- "Publish Version" button only appears when version is Draft
- Not shown for DORMANT items
- Two modes: "Affect Immediately" vs "Affect Later"
- "Affect Immediately": Service Start Time = moment of publish (exact time recorded)
- "Affect Later": User enters future dates for Production Start Time and Service Start Time
- Production Start Time defaults to Service Start Time - 5 days (or now if past)
- Effective end time: defaults to 12/31/2099 23:59, or next version's start time
- Production End Time = production start time of next version

**Extensive validation chain when publishing (sequential):**
1. ERP Info check for truck/commissary/ingredient items
2. Inline error check (sub items deleted/dormant, benchtop sub-items in non-benchtop items, customization mapping, HDR recipe "required for service" requirement, ingredient unit conversion, dormant non-food items, BOM unit != ea for recipe/benchtop/byproduct)
3. Missing info validation check (required errors block; optional-only shows warning but allows "Publish Anyway")
4. Linked preset menu item validation
5. Sub-item status check (all nested sub-items must be published)
6. Variant check in BOM tree
7. 40 item "active for ordering" check (when publishing menu/HDR recipe items)
8. Version resolution for all nested sub-items based on effective time periods
9. Service time availability check
10. Production time order check
11. Warning checks (no food item with Required for Service, missing ERP info, missing customization option values in Merch, non-BOM customization mapping items [MD-17334])
12. Final status update (Draft->Final/Scheduled)

**Post-publish:** Nutrition recalculation, auto-clear HH eligible flag if no HH instruction, version alignment for sub-items. For ingredients: vendor SKU with nutrition/allergen review status validation. R&D Only=Yes: vendor items validation changed from Error to Warning.

### 11. Item Status (`Common Features/Item Status/Item Status.md`)

- Three item statuses: R&D, Active, Dormant
- R&D: Default when first created, stays R&D until a Final version exists
- Active: Auto-change from R&D->Active when future version goes live (publish immediately or when scheduled start time elapses)
- Dormant: User can manually change R&D/Active->Dormant regardless of version status
  - Final version: end time set to dormancy moment
  - Scheduled version: turns into Draft
  - Draft version: no change
- Undormant: Dormant->R&D. If only expired Final exists, auto-creates new Draft version
- Extensive usage checks before dormancy: components, BOM, customization, menus, byproducts, Merch linkages, assembly instructions, kitting, guest packaging, smallwares, line build, OG, PCS fulfillment
- Status change history recorded with Triggered By, Updated Time, Updated By

**Dormant 40/41 Items (`Common Features/Item Status/Dormant 40-41 Items.md`):**
- Dedicated dormant/undormant logic for 40* and 41* items
- 41* dormant: blocked if "active for ordering"=yes AND linked 40 item is non-dormant. Error references 40 item number.
- 40* dormant: blocked if used in non-dormant/non-expired BOM/customization
- Dormant 41 items shown with dormant icon in Packaged SKUs and Linked WSKUs tab
- Dormant 41 items skipped in Missing Info validation
- Auto-recalculates linked 40 item's nutrition/cost
- All actions recorded in change log

### 12. Item Version Status (`Common Features/Item Version Status.md`)

- Three version statuses: Draft, Scheduled, Final
- Draft: Default when version created, no effective start time
- Scheduled: Auto change from Draft when published with future effective start time
- Final: Auto change from Draft (immediate publish) or Scheduled (time elapsed)
- Transition diagram: Draft -> Final (immediate) or Draft -> Scheduled -> Final (time elapsed)
- Editing published versions: only allow adding published sub-items
- Editing Draft versions: recommend Final (live) version for sub-items, or user can manually select other versions

### 16. Key Findings for MD-17891 (Adding Prep Procedure Card to 7* Items)

Based on the documentation:

1. **Current state**: HDR Recipe (7*) does NOT have a Procedure Card or Appliances & Equipment Card according to the Fields & Cards matrix. Procedure Card is currently for Commissary (800)* and Benchtop only.

2. **Validation gap**: The Procedure card missing info validation (section 17 of Item Validations) currently only applies to Commissary (800)* and Benchtop items. It does NOT list HDR Recipe (7*).

3. **Appliance & Equipment validation**: Resource Name is required for Recipe (all subtypes). Currently, the Appliances & Equipment Card is shown for recipe/88* items (not 7*). Adding Procedure Card to 7* items may also require the Appliance & Equipment Card.

4. **Copy/Create version implications**: If Procedure Card is added to 7* items, the Copy Item logic would need to include it in the "HDR Recipe" copy options, and Create New Version would need to handle copying Procedure Card data for 7* versions.

5. **Publish workflow**: The publish validation for HDR recipe items currently checks BOM service setting and 40-item ordering. If Procedure Card is added, the Procedure validation (at least one line of text) would need to be added to the HDR recipe publish validation chain.

6. **Change History**: The Change History already supports recording Procedure card changes. No changes needed for change history logging.

7. **Missing Info**: The Missing Info framework would need to be updated to include Procedure as required for HDR Recipe (7*) items. Currently it only lists Commissary (800)* and Benchtop.

8. **Dormant 40/41**: Not directly related to 7* items, but the Dormant 40-41 Items documentation shows a separate workflow for 40*/41* dormancy that is distinct from 7* item management.
